rules.directory.title: Rule-set binding directory
rules.directory.selectionHint: Explicitly select a source/application/type binding; the first result is never selected automatically.
rules.directory.total: {{total}} bindings match this query; page {{page}} shows {{shown}}.
rules.registration.title: Register a rule-set binding
rules.registration.subtitle: Register the application, rule type, and exact configuration-center target. No rule content is written.
rules.registration.profileHint: Must exactly match a rule profile configured by the Python Console.
rules.registration.datacenterHint: Leave empty to use the Consul server's default datacenter.
rules.registration.sourcesLoadingHint: The Console supplies source identity and revision; the page never reads or stores credentials.
rules.registration.sourcesEmptyHint: Register Nacos or Consul first from System Management.
rules.registration.sourcesFailed: Could not read the configuration-center directory
rules.registration.sourcesFailedHint: The binding was not submitted. Check service status, then explicitly retry the read.
rules.registration.invalidHint: Check the binding identifier, environment, application, profile, and selected configuration-center target.
rules.registration.conflict: The source or binding has changed
rules.registration.conflictHint: Creation was not confirmed. Refresh the source and directory, check for an existing binding, then register with a new identifier.
rules.registration.failedHint: Review the form and service status; registration does not mean configuration was written.
rules.registration.unknownHint: Do not edit or resend with a new request key. A safe retry uses the same key and identical content.
rules.directory.draftHint: Saving does not publish configuration; reopening retains the original source baseline.
rules.directory.switchDraft: Discard changes and open this draft?
rules.directory.discardHint: Only unsaved local changes are discarded. Saved drafts and configuration-center contents are not deleted or overwritten.
rules.workspace.readFilteredEmpty: No records match the current filters/page. Adjust the selection; this does not mean the system has no data.
rules.deployment.rollbackHint: Rollback is a new publication of historical content against the current source baseline; it does not rewind runtime epochs.
rules.deployment.phaseHint: Command acceptance, validation, configuration write, read-back match and process loading are distinct facts.
rules.deployment.coverage: All expected processes: {{applied}} / {{expected}} applied; {{pending}} pending, {{failed}} failed, {{unknown}} unknown, {{restart}} require restart.
rules.deployment.coverageUnknown: Total target count unknown; {{total}} observed, {{applied}} applied; {{pending}} pending, {{failed}} failed, {{unknown}} unknown, {{restart}} require restart.
rules.deployment.receiptPartialTitle: Instance receipts are not fully converged
rules.deployment.receiptPartial: Some instances are still pending, unknown, or require a restart. Use the receipts below to confirm current application coverage; this does not mean rule validation failed.
rules.deployment.restartHint: Cluster quota may still require restart. Loading a rule or matching read-back does not prove new quota execution; restart-required is not applied.
rules.deployment.schedulerHint: Plans are persisted and executed by the backend, including restore; closing the browser does not cancel them. External configuration conflicts block execution instead of being overwritten.
rules.deployment.timeZoneHint: For example Asia/Shanghai, America/New_York or UTC; not an implicit browser zone.
rules.deployment.civilHint: Enter YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm in the zone above; exact UTC instants are shown before submission.
rules.deployment.ambiguityHint: This civil minute occurs twice during DST rollback. Choose explicitly; a nonexistent minute cannot be submitted.
rules.deployment.planInvalid: Check target/restore versions, future interval, time zone and overlapping plans. Repeated minutes require an explicit occurrence; nonexistent minutes are invalid. Refresh server facts if needed.
rules.deployment.reasonHint: Brief audit explanation; do not include passwords, keys or sensitive business data.
rules.deployment.publishInvalid: Publication is unconfirmed. Keep the content; if target or baseline changed, close this dialog, read current facts and confirm again. Unknown outcomes only permit inspection of the original operation.
rules.deployment.cancelHint: Cancel subsequent backend plan actions only. Prior publications remain facts and current rules are not automatically rolled back. On conflict, keep the plan and read it again.
rules.deployment.actionHint: Action not completed. Check current read state, explicit target and access; inspect the original unknown operation without replaying a write.
rules.workspace.description: Manage complete rule sets from an authoritative source. Confirm drafts, immutable versions, publication and instance application separately.
rules.workspace.emptySource: The authoritative source returned an empty rule set. A draft can start from this empty set.
rules.workspace.readLoading: Reading data for the selected binding.
rules.workspace.readRefreshing: Refreshing while retaining known data for the same target.
rules.workspace.readEmpty: No rules or records were returned. An empty result is not a connection failure.
rules.workspace.readFailed: Reading failed or the target is missing. Retry the read; another binding's data cannot substitute.
rules.workspace.readStale: Refresh failed. The displayed data is the last confirmed value, not current state.
rules.workspace.readPartial: Some configuration is unsupported or invalid. It cannot be frozen or published.
rules.workspace.denied: This session cannot edit rules. The backend still authorizes every request.
rules.workspace.editorDescription: Editing one rule preserves the others. Saving a draft does not write to the configuration center.
rules.workspace.clean: No unsaved content changes. This does not mean published or applied.
rules.workspace.emptyCandidate: The candidate is a complete empty array. Publishing it would clear this binding's rules. No automatic publication occurs.
rules.workspace.selectRecord: Explicitly select or add a rule to edit.
rules.workspace.invalidPreview: Incomplete or invalid fields prevent a validated complete JSON preview.
rules.workspace.validationPassed: Target compatibility validated for this candidate
rules.workspace.validationBlocked: This candidate cannot be frozen or published
rules.workspace.validationIssue: Rule {{number}} has a validation or capability limitation. Review the target compatibility profile.
rules.workspace.actionHint: Check fields, unsaved content and the latest receipt. An unknown result permits only investigation of the original operation, not resubmission.
rules.workspace.commandPending: Waiting for backend confirmation. Duplicate submission is blocked.
rules.workspace.commandSuccess: The backend operation result is confirmed. This does not prove source publication or application by all instances.
rules.workspace.commandFailed: The backend rejected this operation. Your draft remains available for deliberate correction.
rules.workspace.commandConflict: The baseline or revision changed. Your draft is retained. Read the latest state and explicitly discard or re-edit; never overwrite automatically.
rules.workspace.commandUnknown: The outcome is not confirmed. Inspect the original request identity; no automatic resubmission.
rules.workspace.discardDescription: This replaces or clears local edits. The authoritative configuration is unchanged, but unsaved changes will be lost.
rules.workspace.removeDescription: Remove this rule only from the local draft. The configuration center remains unchanged until the complete set is saved and published.
rules.workspace.deleteDescription: Delete the persisted backend draft and discard local unsaved changes, not immutable versions or current source rules.
rules.workspace.freezeDescription: Only saved content validated for the current target can be frozen. Freezing never publishes automatically.

rules.errors.slowRatio: The ratio must be greater than 0 and no greater than 1.
rules.errors.ratio: The ratio must be between 0 and 1, inclusive.
rules.errors.nonNegative: This value must be zero or greater.
rules.errors.systemEnabled: Enable at least one system-protection threshold.

rules.headline: Five Sentinel-compatible rule families · configuration center is the source of truth
rules.headlineDetail: The prototype organizes forms around FlowRule, DegradeRule, SystemRule, AuthorityRule, and ParamFlowRule.
rules.noMatchingRule: No rule matches the current filter
rules.notProduction: The prototype validates only a local draft. Production publishing must write the complete rule set to Nacos or Consul, read it back, and confirm that instances loaded it.
rules.paramCompatibility: classType / object are Sentinel Java expressions for parameter exceptions. A cross-language runtime must validate them in its target codec; they are not a general-purpose type system.
rules.sourceOfTruth: The configuration center is the sole source of truth
rules.systemDisabled: An empty value is serialized as -1, Sentinel's disabled semantic.
rules.title: Rule workspace
rules.types.authority.description: Allow or deny resources by caller origin.
rules.types.authority.label: Authority control
rules.types.degrade.description: Protect downstream dependencies by slow-call, error-ratio, or error-count policy.
rules.types.degrade.label: Circuit breaking
rules.types.flow.description: Control entry traffic by QPS, concurrency, call chain, or related resource.
rules.types.flow.label: Flow control
rules.types.param.description: Limit high-frequency values of a parameter in one resource.
rules.types.param.label: Hot parameter
rules.types.system.description: Protect application-wide entry traffic with QPS, threads, RT, load, or CPU boundaries.
rules.types.system.label: System protection
rules.validationPassed: Sentinel-compatible fields passed local validation. Production publishing must still validate the baseline version, complete snapshot diff, configuration-center writeback, and actual instance load.
rules.versions.immutable: A version is immutable. To adjust it, create a new draft based on that version.
rules.versions.previewOnly: The prototype does not create versions or schedule jobs. Production validates a draft before freezing an immutable snapshot.
rules.versions.subtitle: Complete rule-set snapshots; return to a named baseline after the event.
rules.versions.title: Versions and activation plans
rules.target.title: Configuration-center publication target
rules.target.description: Rules are published to this exact Nacos or Consul location. Credentials remain in the registered source.
rules.target.unconfigured: No publication location has been configured for this binding.
rules.target.dialogHint: The provider must match the registered source. This form never accepts or stores credentials.
rules.target.saveFailed: The target could not be saved. Refresh current source and target revisions, then try again.
